table ip raw {
	chain PREROUTING {
		type filter hook prerouting priority raw; policy accept;
		tcp dport 50 counter packets 0 bytes 0 xt target "CT"
		udp dport 51 counter packets 0 bytes 0 xt target "CT"
		iifname "eth0" counter packets 0 bytes 0 meta nftrace set 1
	}

	chain OUTPUT {
		type filter hook output priority raw; policy accept;
	}
}
table ip mangle {
	chain PREROUTING {
		type filter hook prerouting priority mangle; policy accept;
		tcp dport 60 counter packets 0 bytes 0 xt target "MARK"
		tcp dport 61 counter packets 0 bytes 0 xt target "MARK"
		tcp dport 62 counter packets 0 bytes 0 xt target "CONNMARK"
		tcp dport 63 counter packets 0 bytes 0 xt target "CONNMARK"
		tcp dport 64 counter packets 0 bytes 0 xt target "CONNMARK"
	}

	chain INPUT {
		type filter hook input priority mangle; policy accept;
	}

	chain FORWARD {
		type filter hook forward priority mangle; policy accept;
	}

	chain OUTPUT {
		type route hook output priority mangle; policy accept;
	}

	chain POSTROUTING {
		type filter hook postrouting priority mangle; policy accept;
	}
}
table ip nat {
	chain PREROUTING {
		type nat hook prerouting priority dstnat; policy accept;
		xt match "addrtype" counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump DOCKER
		tcp dport 8080 counter packets 0 bytes 0 xt target "DNAT"
		tcp dport 8081 counter packets 0 bytes 0 xt target "REDIRECT"
	}

	chain INPUT {
		type nat hook input priority srcnat; policy accept;
	}

	chain OUTPUT {
		type nat hook output priority dstnat; policy accept;
	}

	chain POSTROUTING {
		type nat hook postrouting priority srcnat; policy accept;
		ip saddr 172.17.0.0/16 oifname != "docker0" counter packets 0 bytes 0 xt target "MASQUERADE"
		oifname "eth0" counter packets 0 bytes 0 xt target "SNAT"
	}

	chain DOCKER {
		iifname "docker0" counter packets 0 bytes 0 return
		iifname != "docker0" tcp dport 8443 counter packets 0 bytes 0 xt target "DNAT"
	}
}

	chain INPUT {
		type filter hook input priority filter; policy drop;

		meta l4proto ipv6-icmp counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept

		tcp dport 22 counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept
		iifname "eth0" udp dport 53 counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept
		xt match "conntrack" counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept
		tcp dport 24 counter packets 0 bytes 0 xt target "REJECT"
		xt match "hl" counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept
		xt match "ipv6header" counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
		xt match "rt" counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
	}

	chain FORWARD {
		type filter hook forward priority filter; policy drop;
	}

	chain OUTPUT {
		type filter hook output priority filter; policy accept;
	}
}
